name: Round Carousel
description: A 3D rotating carousel of two-sided cards arranged in a cylinder, auto-spinning and draggable with momentum.

name: Text Gather
description: Scattered letters snap into place with a magnetic, gooey burst of motion that pulls your text into focus.

name: ASCII Reveal
description: Turns any photo into live ASCII art, with a soft cursor-tracked porthole that reveals the real image underneath.

name: Emoji Particle
description: Spells out any word in emojis that fly and pop into formation, then scatter from the cursor.

name: Glitter Wrap
description: A glittering starfield of particles warping outward or inward from center, with random sparkle flashes and motion streaks.

name: Gravity Gallery
description: Drop image-filled squares or circles into a Matter.js physics world with gravity, walls, and click-drag tossing.

name: Magnetic Carousel
description: Magnify a row of image bars macOS dock style as the cursor nears, then click any bar to expand it into a large square.

name: Liquid Grid
description: A rippling graph-paper grid that reacts to hover and click, lit by a glow that rides the wave.

name: Image Gallery
description: Continuously stream images that fly outward or spiral from the center, with configurable density, easing, and timing.

name: Hover Image Reveal
description: A hoverable name list that reveals a cursor-following image for each item as you move through the menu.

name: Reactive Grid
description: A canvas grid of shapes that bloom in size as the cursor moves through them, tracing every hover with fluid, physical motion.

name: Smoky Text
description: Animate text with realistic smoke diffusion, customizable reveal directions, trigger modes, and smooth character-based transitions.

name: Draggable Grid
description: An infinitely draggable image canvas with smooth momentum and seamless gallery exploration.

name: Draggable Sticker
description: Drag an image around like a real sticker that peels off the surface, tilts to your motion, and settles back into place.

name: Radial Reveal Button
description: A button whose hover fill wipes outward from the exact point the cursor enters, like a ripple caught mid-expand.

name: Pixel Drift
description: Interactive particle typography that assembles, disperses, and reacts to cursor movement with smooth physics-based animations.

name: Shine Card
description: A dark card with a rippling field of metallic dots that catch the light and tilt toward the cursor in 3D.

name: Juice Effect
description: Fill an image silhouette with gooey, rising-and-falling liquid particles that fuse into organic blobs and scatter from the cursor.

name: Pixel Unfold

name: Chromatic Waves
description: A living rainbow noise field resolved into a dot-matrix grid, its density and hue drifting in slow chromatic waves.

name: Text Lift
description: Stack each letter into a layered 3D extrusion that expands and lifts off the surface when you hover it individually.

name: Coverflow Gallery
description: A smooth 3D coverflow carousel with perspective animation, autoplay, and fully customizable slide titles.

name: Image Spotlight
description: A dark veil over your image that a soft spotlight burns through, following the cursor or sitting fixed in place.

name: Ring Gallery
description: An orbiting ring of image cards that spins continuously and flings into a fresh drift when you drag it.

name: Brush Reveal
description: Text that ghosts until your cursor paints over it, revealing full color exactly where you move slowly.

name: Cursor Image Trail
description: A hover-triggered trail of images that follows the cursor with springy, blurred fade transitions.

name: Falling Text
description: Text that drops in letter by letter or word by word and lands with a springy, gravity-like bounce.

name: Scroll Text Highlight
description: Paragraph text that lights up word by word or letter by letter as visitors scroll past it.

name: Glitter Cursor
description: A GPU-powered trail of twinkling stars that sprays from the pointer, fading and flickering with silky, physically-tuned motion.

name: Moving Gradient Button
description: A pill button with a rotating conic-gradient stroke that spins around the border and blooms into a full glow on hover.

name: Image Flipper
description: A split-flap board of tiles that flips through your photos, each cropped and cast at its own angle.

name: Black Hole
description: A physically convincing 3D black hole — orbiting particles, simulated gravity inflow, and a glowing event horizon rendered entirely in canvas.

name: Infinity Canvas
description: An infinitely zoomable and draggable image gallery with smooth motion, momentum, and immersive navigation.

name: Inkbleed
description: Interactive ink bleed effects that react fluidly to cursor movement, for a liquid, hand-drawn feel.

name: Text Ring
description: A ring of your words spins in place and reacts to hover with speed, pause, or scale.

name: Spiral Images
description: Images flow along an Archimedean spiral vortex from the edge into the center, rotating to follow the tangent and fading at both ends.

name: Video Text
description: Bold text masked with a looping video, so your headline plays like a clip instead of sitting flat.

name: Inkbleed Cursor
description: A pixel trail bleeds behind the pointer on springy per-link physics, in solid, dashed, or wave patterns.

name: Star Burst
description: Radiate glowing streaks outward from a movable focal point to form a twinkling starburst with a soft flower bloom at its core.

name: Elastic Text
description: Draggable text where every letter stretches like elastic and snaps back with a springy bounce.

name: Lightning Cursor
description: A crackling bolt of lightning chases your pointer, forking and re-scrambling in real time as it trails behind every move.

name: Dash Cursor
description: A blocky pixel cursor that dashes after the pointer, leaving a fading trail that can snap onto an invisible grid.

name: Prism Grid
description: A 3D-tiltable grid of boxes that lights each cell in a random color as you move your cursor across it, fading softly back out.

name: Random Letter Swap
description: Swap each letter of a heading vertically on hover, revealing a duplicate glyph in a randomized, staggered order.

name: 3D Text Unfold
description: Characters unfold into place from a 3D-rotated, transparent start state into crisp, upright text.

name: Gyro Rings
description: Nested 3D gimbal rings that spin on their own alternating axes and fling to a flick of the cursor.

name: Line Ripple Background
description: A cursor-reactive flow field of noise-driven line streaks that ripple and swirl across your background.

name: Dot Image Reveal
description: A grid of dots that magnetically opens around your cursor, revealing a hidden image exactly where you point.

name: Dot Scatter
description: Cellular dot-and-dash text that scatters into a soft, drifting cloud wherever you hover.

name: Proximity Orbit
description: Display images in a smooth, interactive circular orbit.

name: Spin Image
description: Orbit a set of images along a tilted 3D ellipse with continuous spin, depth-based scaling, and front-to-back layering.

name: Popcorn Text
description: Text that pops each letter in with a springy, randomly rotated bounce triggered on load, hover, or scroll.

name: Dice Roll
description: Real 3D dice that tumble, hop, and land on a number with a soft contact shadow — click to roll again.

name: Cube Roll Letter Role
description: Each character tumbles through a seamless 3D cube rotation on loop, turning any headline into a hypnotic, self-repeating roll.

name: Click Effects
description: Six punchy click-triggered effects — rings, bursts, particles, crosshairs, wavy trails, and sniper hits — that fire wherever a visitor clicks.

name: Text Noise
description: Canvas-rendered text that dissolves into a shifting fuzz of static, sharpening or scattering on hover, click, and timed glitches.

name: Multi-Effect Cursor
description: A canvas cursor trail with four switchable styles — Constellation, Ribbon, Comet, Bubbles — synced to real time so it looks the same at any refresh rate.

name: Interactive Grid
description: A hover-reactive logo grid that lifts each card and its neighbours in 3D, with an optional glow pulse.

name: Text Distortion
description: Warps any headline into a rippling, WebGL-powered wave of text that breathes with organic motion.

name: Image Group Circle
description: Animated photo cards arranged in orbiting concentric rings around a shared center point.

name: Text Morph
description: Cycle through a word list with a gooey blur-and-scale morph that melts each word smoothly into the next.

name: Tornado
description: A WebGL particle tornado that spirals, glows, and flickers behind your hero — comets streak past and ripple the field on contact.

name: Spring Text
description: A whole word that magnetically chases your cursor and springs home the instant it leaves, trailing soft chromatic color layers as it moves.

name: Rising Lines

name: Reactive Lines
description: A canvas of curved lines that bends and multiplies toward your cursor, turning empty space into a living backdrop.

name: Swipe Stack
description: Flick through a fanned 3D stack of image cards that tilt, scale, and cycle to the back on every swipe.

name: SVG Particle
description: Transform images and SVGs into interactive particle animations with hover and repulsion effects.

name: Curved Marquee
description: A draggable text marquee that flows along a curved SVG path with adjustable speed, curve, and edge fade.

name: Electric Border
description: A crackling, animated electric outline that wraps any frame in a glowing, noise-driven border.

name: Pixel Reveal
description: Dissolve a grid of colored pixel squares to reveal an image, sweeping up, down, left, or right with a ragged, noisy leading edge.

name: Globe
description: An interactive 3D rotating globe with customizable dot or solid landmass fill, geo markers, grid lines, and auto-rotation.

name: Floating Icons
description: Emoji or images rise and drift upward in staggered, organic batches — a lightweight ambient animation for hero sections and empty states.

name: Text Path
description: Scroll repeating text seamlessly along a procedural sine-wave path with adjustable frequency, height, speed, and direction.

name: Rolling Letters
description: Text that rolls into view character by character with a smooth, slot-machine-style GSAP reveal.

name: Blob Text Reveal
description: A gooey blob wipes away one word and paints in the next, revealing each blurred character as it glides past.

name: Text Carousel
description: A prefixed headline that cycles through rotating words with a smooth character, word, or line stagger animation inside a resizing badge.

name: Infinite Text Passage
description: A continuous zoom tunnel that cycles through your text list, each word rushing past the camera into the next.

name: Fluid Trail
description: A glowing, GPU-simulated fluid trail that swirls and drifts behind the cursor with real Navier-Stokes physics.

name: Button Carousel
description: A ring of orbiting buttons that swings a portrait and label into view with every tap.

name: Text Colour Sweep
description: Per-letter reveal animation that sweeps a band of accent color through your text before it settles to its final hue.

name: Liquid Distortion
description: A WebGL liquid-ripple hover effect that distorts your image with fluid, cursor-driven waves.

name: Blur Carousel
description: An image carousel with a soft blur that creeps in on arrow hover and a 3D press-tilt that springs back as each slide advances.

name: Snow Fall
description: Fill any frame with drifting canvas snow, tuning per-flake size, speed, opacity, wind sway, and fall direction.

name: Live Chat

name: Scroll Text Reveal

name: Cursor Image Gallery

name: Type Writer

name: Axis Cursor
description: A precision crosshair cursor with a live X/Y coordinate readout, built for design tools, canvases, and technical interfaces.

name: Sync Scroll
description: An infinite marquee of words that syncs its direction and speed to the visitor's scroll input.

name: Grid Hole
description: An animated wireframe funnel that warps a glowing grid into a gravity well, with drifting particles pulled into the void.

name: Pixelate Image
description: Reveal or conceal an image through a real-time SVG pixelation filter driven by cursor distance or a scroll-triggered tween.

name: Snake Grid
description: A self-playing snake that hunts food across a pixel grid, growing endlessly until it corners itself and restarts.

name: Blinking Squares
description: A grid of independently twinkling squares, shaped by a directional density fade and a cursor-following halo.

name: Text Emerge
description: Words scale and blur in from nothing, staggering outward from a point you choose, for a soft cinematic reveal.

name: Coverflow Carousel
description: An infinite cover-flow reel where the centered image grows into a landscape hero while its neighbors fold into thin slats.

name: Sticker Peel
description: Peel and curl a 3D image sticker away from the surface on hover and press, with realistic bone-driven folding and soft shadows.

name: Cube
description: A 3D particle Rubik's cube that auto-scrambles, tumbles, and rotates on drag.

name: Thunder Strike
description: A GPU-rendered electric lightning shader with animated crackle, color, and angle control.

name: Character Cursor
description: A grid of glitchy characters scrambles to life around your pointer, glowing then decaying into static.

name: Flicker Text
description: Bring text and images to life with customizable flicker and outline effects, triggered on enter or hover.

name: Dust Text Reveal
description: Text that assembles itself from a drifting cloud of glowing dust particles, on hover or scroll into view.

name: Focus Reveal
description: A cinematic headline reveal that snaps each character into focus from a soft blur with a punchy scale-in.

name: Flip Gallery
description: A 3D flip-card gallery with cursor tilt — click either half to turn through your images like cards being dealt.

name: Text Button Cursor
description: A bordered text chip that follows the pointer, cycling through custom phrases and leaving a shrinking, fading trail behind every move.

name: Tetris
description: A self-playing tetris board that stacks pieces, clears lines, and resets forever — a living pixel-grid background.

name: Character Waves
description: A flowing field of ASCII characters driven by layered noise waves that ripple away from the cursor.

name: Pixel LED Display
description: A scrolling dot-matrix LED sign that ticks your text across the screen with authentic glow and flicker.

name: Firework Cursor
description: A GPGPU particle field that trails the pointer with drifting, bloom-lit sparks — a firework that follows every move.

name: ASCII Rain
description: A Matrix-style ASCII rain background with glowing heads, fading tails, and full control over speed, angle, and density.

name: Text Wipe
description: A clip-path text reveal that wipes your headline into view on scroll-in or hover, in any direction.

name: Glitch Text
description: Glitchy, distorted text (or image) reveal with adjustable shake and slice-tear effects that trigger on hover or scroll.

name: Crystal Glow
description: A hover button with a crystalline glare sweep and sparkling accents that catch the light.

name: Domino Text Fall
description: Text characters snap upright from a tilted, invisible stack like falling dominoes, one after another.

name: Cosmic Orb
description: A living galaxy sealed inside a glass sphere, with drifting nebulae, twinkling stars, and a chromatic lens flare at its edge.

name: 3D Stagger Flip
description: Text that flips through a 3D cube rotation, character by character, with a customizable stagger pattern.

name: Slide Fill Button

name: Skew in text effect

name: Spiral Text

name: Gradient Text
description: Animated flowing gradient text with fully customizable colors, direction, speed, and scroll or hover reveal triggers.

name: Liquid Carve Button

name: Twin Galaxy Rings
description: A twin-armed spiral galaxy of drifting particles that swells and streams toward your cursor, built for immersive backgrounds.

name: Tile Cursor

name: Shiny Pill
description: Sweep a bright sheen across a line of text on an endless loop, with tunable shine color and sweep speed.

name: Neon Border
description: A glowing neon line chases your frame's edge with real layered bloom, hugging every corner exactly.

name: Letter Swing
description: Spring-physics letter reveal that swings each character in from a tilted, faded start into place.

name: Water Button
description: A glass button with a real fluid simulation inside — swipe, click, and drag to slosh, splash, and spray a living pool of water.

name: Letter Drop
description: Animated text reveal where each character drops into place with staggered, customizable easing.

name: Type Sequence
description: A typewriter-style text loop that types, holds, and deletes a rotating sequence of phrases with a blinking cursor.

name: Confetti Cursor
description: A custom cursor that bursts colorful confetti particles as they drift, fall, and fade with every move.

name: Circle Cursor
description: A stack of blobs chases your pointer at staggered speeds, merging into one gooey shape as it moves.

name: Spin Cursor
description: A rotating arrow cursor that stretches into its direction of travel, with optional glow and a centered hover label.

name: Dot Cursor
description: A spring-smooth custom dot cursor that morphs into a ring over buttons and snaps to an underline over links.

name: Stagger Text Rise
description: Text that rises into place letter by letter with a spring-powered stagger, triggered on load, hover, or scroll.

name: Mechanical Flip
description: Text that flips into view character by character with a crisp 3D rotation, on page load or hover.

name: Scramble Text
description: Animate text with cinematic glitch reveals and interactive character-based hover effects.

name: Gallery Tunnel
description: A first-person tunnel of image and color slabs that rushes toward the viewer forever, accelerating on pointer press.

name: Spotlight Text
description: Dim a block of text and sweep a soft cursor-following spotlight across it to reveal the bright letters underneath on hover.

name: Fluid Text
description: A headline that's really a live fluid simulation, with dye clipped to fit inside the letterforms as you move the cursor.

name: Scan Grid Button

name: Appear Text

name: Dynamic Weight

name: Ribbon Trails
description: A silky spring-rope trail that chases your cursor, cycling through colors that glow where they cross.

name: Neon Glow Button

name: Image Fold
description: A photo unrolls onto the page like it's being peeled off a cylinder, revealing itself with real 3D depth as you scroll or on load.

name: Direction Hover
description: Text that swaps to an accent-colored copy sliding in from the top or bottom edge the cursor enters, then slides out on leave.

name: Dither Effect 2
description: An animated swirl field rendered as a two-tone ordered dither, tileable behind any layout as a moody background texture.

name: Weight Hover
description: Morph each letter's variable-font weight on hover, staggered letter-by-letter with a spring that eases in and out.

name: Word Globe

name: Aura Cursor

name: Dot Matrix

name: Pixel Card

name: Mesh Text Hover

name: Box Carousel

name: Text Wave

name: Text Vaporize

name: User Cursor

name: Particle Tunnel
description: Flow particles along radial spokes toward a central black void with perspective depth, depth-based fading, and z-sorted overlap.

name: Pulse Lines

name: Kinetic Grid

name: Wave Arcs

name: Particle Sphere

name: Emoji Burst

name: Fluid Image Reveal
description: A WebGL blob mask that dissolves open to reveal your image with organic, fluid motion — on scroll or on load.

name: Text Reveal Wall
description: A shifting wall of scrambling characters that settles into your words, line by line, then dissolves back again.

name: Image Magnifier

name: Crystal Gem
description: A hard-cut 3D gem in polished chrome, spinning on its own axis and draggable with real momentum.

name: Link Preview
description: A floating thumbnail of any linked page revealed on hover, leaning toward your cursor as it moves.

name: Eye Gallery
description: Two arcing rows of photo cards drift past each other in a continuous loop, each row independently timed and shaped.

name: Ascii Radar

name: Stardust
description: A drifting field of glowing stardust particles that flicker and float across any background.

name: Dither Effect
description: An animated dithered noise field that renders your palette through a live 4x4 ordered dither matrix, with a hover-driven repulsion hole.

name: Motion Text Wave
description: Wave-in text animation where each character ripples up from a curved offset into place with springy physics.

name: Mask Text Reveal
description: Text that unveils itself through an animated clip-path mask, sweeping in from any edge or center.

name: Prism Ring Button
description: A button ringed by a slow-spinning rainbow gradient that blooms into a soft glow and closes into a full ring on hover.

name: Dither Reveal
description: A dithered image that ripples on its own and tears open into full colour wherever the cursor sweeps.

name: Magnetic Hover Button
description: A button that pulls toward the cursor from a distance and wipes in a new color on hover.

name: Ascii Flame
description: A living wall of ASCII fire that flickers, drifts, and sparks in real time — fully tunable, zero images.
